summary: Helicopters making high energy manoeuvres within 5 nautical miles of Thetford, up to 800 ft, from 0800 to 2300.
text:
EXER TALON STORM. MULTIPLE HEL WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY 
MANOEUVRES WI 5NM RADIUS OF 523227N 0004240E (THETFORD). ACFT MAY BE 
UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01449 728240. AR-2026-9708/01.
